Command state persists append-only and replays; runs in flight at a crash become interrupted and resume without double execution; completion is idempotent; a real shared executor remains separately gated.

Preauthorizations are record-only, at most seven days, owner-only, revocable and matched by artifact digest; Production dispatch is always blocked at its separate gate.

Project-scoped server onboarding by plain address, environment and secret reference is durable and checked; real connectivity remains gated.

One-time enrollment, per-node token (hash only), identity fingerprint, strictly increasing heartbeat sequence, rotation, revocation, offline detection and runner isolation exist behind an off-by-default Node Agent endpoint; a deployed Node Agent against a real server remains gated.

Admin secret metadata lifecycle (register, replace, rotate, revoke, terminal revoke) without value reveal; real Secret Store rotation and revocation remain gated.
